Rajya Sabha. (Ref: Art: 79}

Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha
The Rajya Sabha is composed ofnotmore than 250 members of whom 12
are nominated by the President and 238 are representatives of the states
and the Union Territories elected by the method of indirect election
{Ref: Art 80}.
The 12 nominated members are chosen by the President from amongst
persons specialised in science, art; literature and social service
Representatives of each State are elected by the elected members of
the Legislative Assembly of the state in accordance with the system of
proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote
